heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 101–510, div. A, title XV, § 1532(b)(2), Nov. 5, 1990, 104 Stat. 1733

notes.text: Section, acts Mar. 3, 1883, ch. 130, § 1, 22 Stat. 564; July 26, 1947, ch. 343, title II, § 205(a), 61 Stat. 501, related to annual report of board of commissioners of Soldiers’ Home.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective one year after Nov. 5, 1990, see section 1541(a) of Pub. L. 101–510, formerly set out as an Effective Date note under section 401 of this title.
